posts.author: neajiloso
posts.body:
Hey there! My online name is Neaj (rhymes with "ledge" like on the edge of a ledge with Neaj).
I’ve been a lurker around here since 2021 (when I joined and *thought* I was going to start posting, but... posting anxiety). I’ve mostly been reading threads and messing around with RPG Maker in my spare time.
A bit of my background:
Game development has been a pAsSiOn/hobby of mine since high school - more so the programming side. Way back when, my friend asked me to learn programming so he could make art in our little duo dev team.... which eventually fell apart. The interest always stuck with me.
I stepped away from programming and development for a while during college, two grad school experiences, and the start of my current career, but lately I’ve been diving back in. I’ve been relearning Java for fun/other projects and JavaScript specifically for RPG Maker MZ. I’ve recently been challenging myself with some customization work and custom logic.
I started with VX Ace back in the day, moved to MV (and was finally in my comfy coding language space of JavaScript), and eventually transitioned over to MZ, where I’ve been slowly working on a (probably terrible) personal passion project.
Not totally sure why now is the time I finally decided to post, but I’m hoping to be more active in the community... more than likely ask a lot of questions after slamming my head through the neighbor's wall (mine is already gone), share things (maybe get feedback?), and maybe connect with others who share similar interests.
Looking forward to chatting and hopefully helping/collaborating! but let's face it posting anxiety, ha!

posts.body: Glad you said hello and good luck on your projects!
